newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr at 181.17/22.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr at 181.17/22.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed weaker against the dollar on Thursday, with very little speculation or investor interest in the Hungarian unit, dealers said.
The forint closed at 181.17/22 to the dollar, marginally weaker than its 181.12/17 morning close, and just five pips off the National Bank of Hungary resistance level, dealers said.
"There was very little moving and a lack of any kind of speculation," said Gabriella Andrade, of Budapest Bank.
She said American investors appeared to be holding back, hoping that the dollar would hit 1.72 against the German mark.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
